A prototype weapon designed by the Black Shores for elite combatants.
These pistols takes their name from the devastating might of a blazar — a galactic nucleus whose blinding radiance pierces the cosmos, shining unmistakably across billions of light years.

Fusion Accretion is a Rectifier weapon in Wuthering Waves.
